name: sdsi
description: Software Development Standard Instructions (SDSI) — a language-neutral development standard split into topic skills that grow independently. sdsi:core holds the non-negotiable rules, the project profile (language, project type), and the review-or-apply question every skill asks before touching existing code. Topics: sdsi:workflow, sdsi:standards, sdsi:config, sdsi:secrets, sdsi:logging, sdsi:errors, sdsi:concurrency, sdsi:testing, sdsi:dependencies, sdsi:docs, sdsi:versioning, sdsi:deploy. Project types own layout and entry point: sdsi:web, sdsi:mw, sdsi:cli. sdsi:all runs every step in core's fixed order. Ships a scripted release chain (git hooks + release.py) that bumps VERSION, promotes CHANGELOG.md, closes TODO.md items, and writes the version as the commit message.
